[[File:Egan.png|250px|thumb|right|Egan]] '''Egan''' (Japanese: '''ヤケイシ''' ''Yakeishi'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP240|Some Like it Hot]]''. Egan is a {{type|Fire}} {{pkmn|Trainer}}, and like {{an|Misty}}, he wanted to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} and raise only Pokémon of his preferred [[type]]. As a result, he wanted a {{pkmn2|giant}} {{p|Magcargo}} that was blocking {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}' path towards [[Blackthorn City]]. However, the Magcargo was very powerful, and Egan's first attempt to battle it ended in failure. His impulsive behavior and sharp comments sparked an intense rivalry with Misty over whether Fire-types or {{type|Water}}s were the best. Over lunch, Misty decided to settle their differences, and the pair began to get along. Egan had a [[rematch]] against the Magcargo and, after heeding Misty's advice of adaptability in a match, defeated and caught it. Misty and Egan teamed up to defeat {{TRT}} with a combined {{m|Flamethrower}} and {{m|Water Gun}} attack. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} The following are Egan's known Pokémon: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Egan |pkmn=Flareon |type1=Fire |img=Egan Flareon.png |epnum=EP240 |epname=Some Like It Hot |vajp= |vaen=Kayzie Rogers |desc={{p|Flareon}} is Egan's main Pokémon. He used it to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} a {{p|Magcargo}}. During the first try, Flareon was unsuccessful, as Magcargo's defenses and follow-up attacks easily subdued it. Later, Flareon battled Magcargo again. Using {{an|Misty}}'s strategies, Flareon tackled Magcargo after it used {{m|Withdraw}} and was able to weaken it, which allowed Egan to catch it. Flareon's known moves are {{m|Tackle}}, {{m|Quick Attack}}, and {{m|Flamethrower}}.
It also knows a move variation of {{m|Flame Wheel}} known as Flaming Tackle.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Egan |pkmn=Magcargo |type1=Fire |type2=Rock |img=Egan Magcargo.png |epnum=EP240 |epname=Some Like It Hot |vajp= |vaen=Eric Stuart |desc={{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} first stumbled upon this {{pkmn2|giant}} {{p|Magcargo}} after it was blocking the path towards [[Blackthorn City]]. Ash yelled at it, causing Magcargo to wake up in a rage and retaliate with Flamethrower. {{an|Misty}} sent out her {{TP|Misty|Poliwhirl}} to deal with it, but Magcargo's protective shell was a great defense against its {{m|Water Gun}} and it knocked Poliwhirl out with another Flamethrower. Egan tried to catch it, though his {{p|Flareon}} was ultimately defeated as well. Egan later caught Magcargo with the help of his Flareon. Afterwards, {{TRT}} stole it, but Egan was able to get it back. Magcargo used its {{t|Fire}} [[move]]s to subdue [[Jessie's Arbok]] and [[James's Victreebel]]. Finally, with the help of Misty's Poliwhirl, Magcargo was able to blast them off. Magcargo's known moves are {{m|Rock Slide}}, {{m|Body Slam}}, and {{m|Flamethrower}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{fire color}}|bordercolor={{fire color light}} |ja=柳沢三千代 ''Michiyo Yanagisawa'' |en=[[Tara Jayne]] |es_la=Enzo Fortuny |es_eu=Marisa Marco |fr_eu=Julie Basecqz |it=Cinzia Massironi |pl=Renata Berger |pt_br=Francisco Freitas }} {{-}} {{Project COD notice}} [[Category:Johto characters of the day]] [[Category:Fire-type Trainers]] [[Category:Male characters]] [[Category:Animation characters]] [[es:Egan]] [[fr:Egan]] [[it:Egan]] [[zh:亚克西]]
